feature_name: Studio Core Update and Accelerate URL Handling
description: Update the Prisma CLI's Studio component to use the latest @prisma/studio-core version and improve connection URL validation. Specifically, remove legacy Accelerate URL transformation logic and provide clear error messages when users attempt to use unsupported Accelerate URLs with Studio. Ensure validation errors are displayed cleanly without stack traces.
functional_requirements: Update the @prisma/studio-core dependency in the CLI package to version 0.15.0 or later
Remove all legacy logic that transforms Accelerate-style URLs (prisma:// and prisma+postgres://) within the Studio command
Implement early validation that fails with a clear, user-friendly error message when Accelerate URLs are provided to the studio command
Route Studio validation errors through the help() function to display clean error messages without technical stack traces
Maintain successful startup for valid database URLs (like standard postgresql:// connections)
Add appropriate test coverage for the new URL validation behavior
